subject: Vendr account & evidence ownership — scope and upload plan
messages:
From: Erin Caldwell <erin.caldwell@cedartech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Intake <security-intake@cedartech.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial vendor onboarding — Vendr account and evidence scope

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're kicking off CedarTech's vendor security intake for Redwood and want to confirm the right owners and the minimum evidence set to get you fully provisioned in Vendr. We typically request:

- Current SOC 2 Type 2 report (last 12 months)
- SIG/CAIQ mapping or a bridge document (if you maintain one)
- Data flow diagram and retention table (S3/bucket names OK as examples)
- Proofs for KMS/HSM and encryption-at-rest (snippets or redacted configs)
- List of sub‑service providers and data processors

We can invite you to our Vendr workspace — I will send an invite that includes scoped roles (uploader, owner, read-only). Can you confirm: who should be the primary owner for uploads and who owns the SOC2/controls artifacts? Also share any preferred file naming conventions or deadlines for the initial bulk upload.

I attached a short template we prefer for mapping CAIQ controls -> your docs.

Thanks,
Erin Caldwell
Security Operations | CedarTech
erin.caldwell@cedartech.com

Attachment: cedartech-caiq-template.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Erin Caldwell <erin.caldwell@cedartech.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding — Vendr account and evidence scope

Erin — thanks, this is helpful.

Quick answers:
- Primary uploader/owner: Priyom Das (Security Program Manager) — priom will own the actual uploads and mapping.
- Controls contact: Ben Carter (Infra Security) will be the technical lead for SOC2 artifacts and KMS details.
- Preferred file naming: <company>_<doc-type>_<YYYYMMDD> (we'll follow your template too).
- Target for first pass upload: EOD Friday, 2026-11-12, if that works for you.

I attached our internal onboarding checklist so we can align on which items you want in the initial bundle versus follow-up deliverables.

Next steps from our side: Priyom will accept the Vendr invite, Ben will prep a redacted SOC2 bridge pdf (we can redact control test data), and I'll coordinate the upload window so we don't overwhelm the portal with large files.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
Dylan_Brooks@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-vendr-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Erin Caldwell <erin.caldwell@cedartech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Intake <security-intake@cedartech.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding — Vendr account and evidence scope

Dylan — invite sent, role set to 'Uploader' for Priyom and 'Admin (limited)' for Ben. You should see an email from vendr-noreply@vendr.example.com with an activation link (I've also pasted a one-time link below).

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- SOC2: redacted bridge PDF is fine — we only need the description of control tests and date ranges.
- CAIQ: if you can map high-risk controls in the first upload (those affecting encryption, key management, access control, and data residency) that will get us to a provisional review faster.
- Evidence size: if the bundle >500MB split into a couple of uploads and label them part1/part2.

One-time portal link: https://vendr.example.com/invite/AXY-2389

I'll start the initial review once Priyom completes the upload. If anything blocks the upload (SSO, 2FA), ping me directly and I'll engage our directory team.

Cheers,
Erin

Attachment: cedartech-soc2-bridge.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr account & evidence ownership — scope and upload plan

Thanks — I accepted the invite and verified upload access. Two quick asks before I start the bulk:

1) Can Ben confirm which S3 buckets we will include as examples (names only) and whether we should provide retention policy excerpts or the full lifecycle config?
2) Ben, for KMS: do you prefer we provide a short architecture diagram + key rotation cadence (redacted), or the KMS policy JSON? The portal doesn't need raw keys, just the policy and rotation proof.

I'll do an initial push of the high-risk CAIQ mappings tonight (part1) and SOC2 bridge tomorrow morning (part2). If Erin needs the lane split differently, let me know.

-Priyom
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
